reason: C2 is chosen because it proposes a concrete intervention (addition of a specific alloying element known to induce lattice distortion) with a specific mechanism (lattice distortion leading to nano-scale precipitates or defects that increase strength and enhance plastic deformation) that is physically consistent and specific to the eutectic high-entropy alloy system. It also provides quantified predictions (20% increase in yield strength and 30% increase in elongation to failure) and a decisive falsification test (tensile testing and microstructural characterization with clear criteria for falsification). While other candidates also propose interventions and mechanisms, C2 stands out for its detail, specificity, and the clarity of its falsification experiment, making it a stronger hypothesis
